items.item: 08 §2 Widening bullet: 'So ranking by widening adds no premise' (H19)
items.how: Now 'Ranking by widening adds no premise beside the life's own concern: where the condition holds, that concern already does it (the bullet above).' The reason is the self-concern bullet, not the weighting theorem before it.

items.item: 08 §2 lead paragraph by H14, H15, H16(a)
items.how: After the across-all-steps sentence: 'Read in time, it holds only from some step on, and there exactly where each one's acts, from every step, come to bear on every other's later continuation (07 §4.11).' Then the anchor's self-concern definition: 'Where it holds read across all steps, a course widens another when it keeps all the other keeps and lets more form, more future, and whatever it adds lies within the life's own reach. Call a life's order over courses self-concerned when it ranks above what it widens every widening that adds to its own continuation, read as what lies within its reach (Weighting.IncreasingInOwn, its marking reading the center's closure): there, that order already ranks every widening above what it widens (increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_of_unrestricted).' The 'Emerges' sentence now says 'on a finite listing and between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, with admission decided, so that their admissions end' (no 'one way'). I wrote 'Where it holds read across all steps' where the anchor has 'There': the ranking theorem takes Unrestricted, and the from-some-step-on form is a different predicate, so no theorem gives the ranking under the in-time reading (see for_ren).

items.item: 08 §2 'The condition, read on relations' by H16(a) full form and H16(b)
items.how: Added the full in-time form: fails over every step wherever there is a formation (Flow.not_unrestricted_inTime); from some step on exactly where each one's acts, from every step, come to bear on every other's later continuation (Flow.unrestrictedEventually_iff_mutuallyDependentInTime); over every later step it asks more, coupling at every next step (Flow.unrestrictedAfter_iff_coupledEachStep), which gives the first (UnrestrictedAfter.eventually) and is not given by it (RingOfThree.apart); mutual dependence in time can lapse (Drawing.lapses). One-center: 'Where «续无外» holds, on an acyclic relation every standpoint has the same center («续无外则同一中心»); on a net going forward in time this comes from the condition's asking that nothing other than the center lie at or before the center's step («续无外当且仅当后与独», «独则同一中心»), and over what comes after («续无外于后») two centers can meet it (TwoSources.apart).' 'Over what comes after' is used only for «续无外于后», never joined with 'come to bear'; 'and only from the steps where they do' appears nowhere.

for_ren: 08 §2 'Where the ethics sits' now defines self-concern where it is used, in the anchor's words: 'Call a life's order over courses self-concerned when it ranks above what it widens every widening that adds to its own continuation, read as what lies within its reach: there, that order already ranks every widening above what it widens.' It says 'Where it holds read across all steps' where the anchor says 'There', because no theorem gives the ranking under the in-time reading (the anchor's 'There' after 'Read in time …' can be read that way).

C is now defined with its parameter in 08 §2, the premise card and both glossaries: a requirement that an order rank every extension above what it extends, an extension keeping every realized claim and realizing some claim counted as living; only with every claim counted as living (on level paths, in the self-concern result) is it 'rank each course above every course it widens'.

08 §12 item 12, 'How scope and order form', now says what route (b)'s join and J2 give: at the formations whose acts return, along affecting, under each one's least class, the condition is exactly mutual dependence (given one such formation); persisting gives a filter, choices consistent with keeping above ending and with self-concern on the occasions met wherever only ending was at stake there; such orders give C only between listed level paths met together, and the course a persisting line takes is never one; standing late does not tell a wider reading from a narrower one whose acts agree on what couples in. How such orders and scopes form stays open.

'One way' in English now names only relations running one way; the path result's direction is stated by the sentence itself ('ranks every widening above'), with decided admission and the finite list said wherever the path result is.
